scenes.title: Act 01 - The Merchant Problem & Live Seed State
scenes.script: Small businesses lose thousands every month chasing unpaid invoices, reconciling subscriptions, and defending buyer disputes. Meet PayPulse: an autonomous AI CFO built on live PayPal Sandbox APIs and AG Studio 3.1. Our merchant book opens with 7,920 dollars invoiced, 4,710 collected, 2,750 overdue, and a 59.5 percent collection rate.

scenes.title: Act 02 - Command Center & AG Studio 3.1 Relational Analytics
scenes.script: Inside the Command Center, PayPulse feeds live receivables, loyalty tiers, and subscriptions into an embedded AG Studio 3.1 canvas. Relational joins link invoices to customers while calculated expressions compute collection rate in real time across Executive Cashflow, Overdue and Buy Now Pay Later, and Subscriptions.

scenes.title: Act 03 - Deal Desk Happy Path: Live Invoicing, Orders & QR
scenes.script: On the Deal Desk, the Deal and Billing Agent converts natural language into live PayPal mutations. Local Ollama processes the request to bill Alex Mercer 450 dollars for an AI Vision Pipeline milestone. PayPulse dispatches a live Sandbox invoice, creates a Checkout Order, and renders a scannable PayPal QR code.

scenes.title: Act 04 - Recurring Subscriptions & Deterministic-First Reliability
scenes.script: Next, local Ollama launches a 79 dollar monthly Enterprise AI Retainer plan. PayPulse provisions a live PayPal Catalog Product and Billing Plan in seconds. PayPulse is deterministic-first: even when Ollama is offline, the deterministic router guarantees zero-downtime execution.

scenes.title: Act 05 - Collections Nudge-Bot & 50% Pay Later Split
scenes.script: The Collections Nudge-Bot targets invoice PP-2026-005 for Priya Nair at FinEdge Global, overdue by 1,600 dollars. With one instruction, the agent drafts a personalized recovery note, creates a 50 percent milestone split invoice for 800 dollars, and attaches a PayPal Pay Later checkout order.

scenes.title: Act 06 - Webhook Room: Autonomous Dispute Shield & Unhappy Paths
scenes.script: In the Webhook Room, the Dispute-Shield Agent defends every unhappy path. A 480 dollar Item Not Received dispute triggers carrier verification and multipart evidence upload to PayPal's Disputes API. An 18 dollar 50 cent claim below the 25 dollar threshold is auto-refunded to avoid a 15 dollar fee. A denied capture is escalated, and a paid webhook reconciles the ledger live.

scenes.title: Act 07 - 3D Isometric Architecture & Partner Ecosystem Matrix
scenes.script: Under the hood, PayPulse unites eight core capabilities: Invoicing and QR, Orders v2 and Pay Later, Catalog Subscriptions, Dispute Evidence and Tracking, AG Studio 3.1 relational analytics, APIMatic SDK patterns with 8.5-hour OAuth caching, local Ollama tool routing, and zero-vulnerability security hardening.
